subject: Call rescheduling and ticket update
text:
Hello,

Sorry to mess this around, but I need to move the technical call we had penciled in for later today. I first thought we still needed it because the ticket showed an unresolved connection error, then I noticed the latest update from your team, and it turns out the router replacement solved everything overnight. That is actually better than I expected. I also may have written the wrong day in my notes, so ignore the reminder that said Thursday if your confirmation says Tuesday. The important point is the service status, not the calendar entry, but I do not want your team showing up unnecessarily or getting blamed for a slot I created out of habit. Could we still keep a very brief slot tomorrow morning if you want to walk through the billing note, or are you happy to close the case now? I have two possible windows: just after ten, or late afternoon, though one of those may still conflict with a vendor training. Please tell me what works, and if you would rather cancel the call altogether, I can record the good outcome, mark the ticket resolved, and make sure no further dispatch charges are added. Sorry again for the back-and-forth. I appreciate your patience with this.

Thanks.
